summary:
All 3 rounds pass.

**The bug:** `InstallSnapshot` updated `lastApplied` to the snapshot index but never updated `commitIndex`. On `Restart()`, the saved `commitIndex` was `0`, so after restoring the snapshot (which set `lastApplied = 10`), the else-branch dragged `lastApplied` back down to `0`. When the new leader then sent entries 11–13 with `leaderCommit=13`, `applyEntries()` re-applied entries 1–10 from the still-intact log.

**The fix** (`snapshot.go:56`): set `n.commitIndex = snap.LastIncludedIndex` alongside `n.lastApplied`, so restart recovery correctly anchors at the snapshot boundary instead of resetting to zero.
